assessment: This article describes the role of vitamin C in promoting plasma cell differentiation by remodeling the epigenome via TET family proteins. Activated Tet2/Tet3 actively demethylate selected genomic regions, including the genetic locus encoding Blimp-1, the master transcription factor of plasma cell differentiation. This article will be of interest to scientists in molecular immunologists, particularly those involved in epigenetic mechanisms of B cell differentiation to plasma cells.
